content.text:
cd /workspace/project && python3 - <<'PY'
p='AKSES.md'; t=open(p).read()
old="""- **Gratis 7 hari** dengan **$100 kredit API** (plan 1x)
- **Gratis 4 jam/hari** edisi uncensored, 16:00-20:00 Madrid = **22:00-02:00 WIB**
- Harga setelah trial: $17/bln (termasuk $100 API)"""
new="""- **KOREKSI 17 Nov:** TIDAK ADA $100 kredit gratis saat daftar. Klaim awal salah.
  `$100` = editionCredit **di dalam plan berbayar** $17/bln (creditMicrousd=0,
  editionCreditMicrousd=100000000). Trial 7 hari butuh **kartu** (Stripe).
- Yang benar-benar gratis (dari `/api/models` -> `freeAllowance`):
  ```
  chatTurnsPerDay        : 20
  apiRequestsPerDay      : 50        <- 50 request API/hari, GRATIS
  apiRequestMaxMicrousd  : 90000     <- maks $0.09 per request
  apiRequestMaxPromptTokens: 96200   <- maks 96k token prompt
  ```
- Jendela gratis: **16:00-20:00 Madrid = 22:00-02:00 WIB** (di luar itu traffic tutup)
- Daftar email TIDAK memberi kredit; key diambil di `/dashboard#keys`
- Base URL: `https://api.lebrel.ai/v1` (chat completions),
  `https://attested.lebrel.ai/v1` (mode responses/Codex, wire_api="responses")
- Plan berbayar: $17/bln (editionCredit $100), $69 (5x, $500), $199 (20x, $2000)"""
assert old in t
t=t.replace(old,new)
open(p,'w').write(t); print("ok")
PY
ok


git add -A && git -c user.name="openhands" -c user.email="openhands@all-hands.dev" commit -q -m "Fix: Lebrel has no \$100 signup credit; real free tier = 50 API req/day in 22-02 WIB window" && git --no-pager log --oneline -1
